description: **A missing optional pack is recorded in the kit and refused at launch**: `proxy/tools/pc_deploy.py` (kit build): when `build_fixed_sky_pack` fails the kit is built without the pack and only a warning prints; record `<pack>: absent` in the kit manifest and make `harness/ctl.py` `Pc.launch` refuse when an `add` rule's source is not installed Why: the first sign is otherwise a `shot_match` failure that looks like a lighting regression (napoleon J44: diff 9.6 to 11 against threshold 4); in the next job that changes `pc_deploy.py` anyway Raised: napoleon J44 review Later 3, 2026-11-04
title: A missing optional pack is recorded in the kit and refused at launch
